summary: Challenge to validity of Rule 19 of Development Control Rules (DCR) re: Open Space Regulation (OSR) area; gift deed executed in 1994 to CMDA; failure by authorities to develop OSR as park; residents' association sought to maintain OSR as park; division bench allowed writ appeals, set aside single judge order; Supreme Court upholds civic authorities' right to use OSR for road development; emphasis on public interest, traffic decongestion; no enforceable right of residents' association over OSR; multiple connected appeals including challenge to vires of Rule 19 and SLPs reviewed; validity of Rule 19 upheld; appeals dismissed with no costs.
legal_provisions_cited: Entry 42 of List III, Seventh Schedule
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; impugned judgment allowing writ appeals and setting aside single judge order upheld; no costs.
